repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability dashboard designed to track the performance, token consumption, and cost of coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python, providing a local-first architecture to ensure data privacy for sensitive development workflows.
Integrates directly with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to monitor granular work steps.
Provides detailed cost-per-task analysis, including token usage, file modifications, and test execution metrics.
Enables developers to audit agent efficiency and optimize prompt engineering based on real-world expenditure.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, local-first dashboard for A-share market analysis that combines deterministic financial metrics with AI-driven sentiment synthesis.
bullets: Uses a hybrid architecture: pure deterministic computation for financial indicators and AI for narrative market synthesis.
Features a comprehensive suite of market metrics including limit-up pools, liquidity flows, and sentiment cycles.
Designed for local execution, supporting subscription-based models to bypass API key dependencies.
Ideal for quantitative traders needing a real-time, visual overview of market momentum and sector-specific capital movement.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, multimodal time-series visualization and data infrastructure tool built in Rust.
bullets: Engineered in Rust as a high-performance fork of Rerun, optimized for low-latency data processing.
Native ROS 2 support allows for seamless integration with existing robotics and sensor-heavy data pipelines.
Capable of reading and visualizing legacy .rrd recordings, making it highly compatible with existing research stacks.
Provides a robust framework for visualizing complex, high-frequency time-series data common in both robotics and high-frequency trading environments.
